integrity: The polynomial equilibrium classification is proved analytically and checked using standalone rational arithmetic; finite verification is not an exhaustive proof. The scientific review is internal to this package and no independent validation has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Exact homogeneous-reaction equilibrium classification and local homogeneous stability only; no assertion about diffusion-driven instability, nonlinear global basins, kinetic-limit validity, or empirical population parameters. The specific historical priority remains literature-bounded.
title: A sharp coexistence wedge from predator-induced refuge carrying capacity
